name: @agentmailbox/mcp-auth
stderr:
Usage: npx @agentmailbox/mcp-auth <mcp-url> <token-endpoint> [scope]

Arguments:
  mcp-url        The MCP server URL (e.g., https://mcp.agentmailbox.to/tenant/mytenant/mailbox/admin)
  token-endpoint The OAuth2 token endpoint (e.g., https://auth.agentmailbox.to/oauth2/token)
  scope          Optional OAuth2 scope (default: mcp-api/email.full)

Environment variables:
  MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID          Your OAuth2 client ID (required)
  MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET      Your OAuth2 client secret
  MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE Path to file containing client secret (more secure)
  MCP_DISABLE_CERT_PINNING     Set to "true" to disable certificate pinning (for corporate proxies)
  MCP_DEBUG                    Set to "true" to enable debug logging (never logs secrets)
